llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam characteristics: offering branded clothing/cosmetics at discounted prices without any legitimate business information, contact details, or company registration; lacks About, Contact, Privacy Policy, or Terms pages; handles a wide array of unrelated products; and misuses secure payment claims. Such omissions are red flags for scam sites intending to impersonate legitimate retailers and dupe consumers out of funds with no intention of fulfillment.
